purpose: Curator-supplied phrase ontology for EU R&I radar admission/discovery. Strand C phrases are retrieval/re-ranking aids only; C admission is relational to substantive Strand A evidence.

principles.strand_a: Substance: EU R&I where it meets security, sovereignty, competitiveness, dependencies and foreign policy.
principles.strand_b: Method: foresight/futures methodology usable to study the future of Strand A.
principles.strand_c: Weak signals: new facts/evidence/developments that materially reframe an existing Strand-A issue. C is a relationship to A, not a keyword class.
principles.c_admission_rule: Never admit to C on a C phrase alone. A C phrase may retrieve or re-rank a candidate; admission still requires a substantive Strand-A anchor plus a distinct new point/implication.
principles.duplicate_rule: Prior coverage of the topic is not disqualifying. Collapse only substantially the same event/claim/implication.
